title: Add Calendar View
content: Create calendar component. Header: flex justify-between, month/year title, prev/next buttons. Weekday labels: grid grid-cols-7 text-center text-sm text-gray-500. Days grid: grid grid-cols-7. Day cell: min-h-[80px] p-1 border, hover:bg-gray-50. Day number: text-sm, today highlighted with bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-full. Events: small colored bars or dots, max 3 visible with "+N more" link. Click day: show day detail or open event creation.

variants.simple: Create monthly calendar with event display.
variants.detailed: Create calendar component. Header: flex justify-between, month/year title, prev/next buttons. Weekday labels: grid grid-cols-7 text-center text-sm text-gray-500. Days grid: grid grid-cols-7. Day cell: min-h-[80px] p-1 border, hover:bg-gray-50. Day number: text-sm, today highlighted with bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-full. Events: small colored bars or dots, max 3 visible with "+N more" link. Click day: show day detail or open event creation.
variants.advanced: Create full calendar component with multiple views. Views: month, week, day, agenda (list). Header: view switcher buttons, prev/today/next navigation, current period display. Month view: 6-week grid always showing, days from adjacent months in lighter color. Day cell: date number (today circled), events stacked as colored bars with title, overflow "+N more" opens popover. Week view: 7-column grid with time slots on left (hourly), events as positioned blocks based on time/duration. Day view: single column with time slots, detailed event blocks. Agenda view: scrollable list of upcoming events grouped by date. Event rendering: colored by category/calendar, drag to reschedule, resize to change duration. Event popover: click event to show details (title, time, location, description), edit/delete buttons. Event creation: click+drag on empty slot to create, quick-add modal. Multiple calendars: toggle visibility, color-coded. Recurring events: show with repeat icon. All-day events: separate row at top of day. Timezone support: display timezone, convert times. Keyboard nav: arrow keys to navigate days, Enter to select. Today button: quick return to current date.
